app.name: Varmestart
app.tagline: A warm car when you walk out the door

noNumber.title: Add the module's number
noNumber.body: Varmestart only needs the phone number of the SIM card in the EasyStart GSM module.

sheet.title: Send SMS
sheet.whyBody: iPhone and Google Play do not let apps send SMS without you tapping Send. Varmestart fills in everything; you tap once.

explain.stop: Stops the heater and clears any scheduled start.
explain.startAt: Starts the heater at {time}. The module keeps the time itself.
explain.temp: Asks the module for the temperature.
explain.status: Asks the module for status and fault codes.

plan.title: Plan a start
plan.summary: The heater starts at {start}; the car is warm by {depart}.

empty.title: No weekly schedules yet
empty.body: Create one, for example Work Mon–Fri 07:00. The app sends the START command for you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.phoneHelp: The number of the SIM card in the EasyStart GSM module, not your own.

modes.composeDesc: Opens the SMS app with everything filled in. You tap Send.
modes.directDesc: Sends SMS in the background. Android Pro (APK) only.
modes.automationDesc: iOS Shortcuts sends for you on weekly schedules.
modes.reminderDesc: Notification with “Send now” at send time.

settings.exactAlarmHelp: Android needs this to send on the second.
settings.pinHelp: Used only for configuration commands. Default 1234.
settings.notAffiliated: Varmestart is not affiliated with Eberspächer. EasyStart is a trademark of Eberspächer.
settings.privacy: Everything is stored on your phone. No data is collected.

welcome.title: A warm car with one SMS
welcome.body: Varmestart controls your Eberspächer heater through the EasyStart GSM module. All you need is the module's phone number.

number.title: Module phone number
number.body: The number of the SIM card in the module. Your own number must be registered in the module for it to respond.

test.title: Test the connection
test.body: Send STATUS to the module. With confirmations on, it replies within a minute.

done.title: Ready!
done.body: Tap Start whenever you want heat. Add weekly schedules so you never have to remember.

note.ios: On iPhone, Messages opens with everything filled in. You tap Send. Weekly: reminder the evening before, or a Shortcuts automation.
note.android: The store version opens the SMS app with everything filled in. You tap Send. Google Play does not allow background sending.
note.androidPro: The Pro version sends SMS directly and in the background on weekly schedules, and reads replies from the module.
